WHAT: Vinted's `GET /api/v2/catalog/items?search_by_image_uuid=<uuid>` also accepts `size_ids[]` as a query parameter, just like the text search endpoint.
HOW: In the search route, when fetching top matches via UUID, pass the same `sizeId` that's used for text search: `?search_by_image_uuid=<uuid>&size_ids[]=<sizeId>`.
WHY: Without this, Top Matches show all sizes regardless of user's L/30/44 preference — defeats the purpose of size settings.
GOTCHA: If the visual search + size filter combo returns 0 results, fall back to visual search without size filter rather than showing nothing.
